summary: Targeted verification for production horoscope bug. Confirmed the deployed site (luxsexiaiii.com) is running an OUTDATED backend (returns SPA index.html with content-type text/html for /api/horoscope/daily, which is the exact root cause of the 'Os astros estão em silêncio agora' error users see). The CURRENT preview build is fully working: backend /api/horoscope/daily returns valid JSON for aries/touro/virgem in pt (5/5 pytest cases pass), UI DailyReadingModal populates daily-reading-content (no error state), and the home HoroscopeFeedCard renders horoscope-feed-reading after picking a sign. Regression checks (feed posts, article share menu) also pass. Redeploy will fix production.
action_items: REDEPLOY production (luxsexiaiii.com) — the deployed backend is out of date and does not include /api/horoscope routes. .gitignore blocker was already fixed so the next deploy will include env vars and the new routes.
After redeploy, re-run: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{content_type}\n' https://luxsexiaiii.com/api/horoscope/daily?sign=aries&lang=pt — must return application/json (currently returns text/html).
seed_data_creation: None (LLM readings cached per sign/date/lang in Mongo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Production issue is a deploy staleness problem, not a code bug. Preview build at premium-space-2.preview.emergentagent.com is green across horoscope daily (aries/touro/virgem lang=pt), personal SSE, home feed card, and share menu. If retesting after redeploy, just verify deployed /api/horoscope/daily returns application/json and the modal at /bem-estar/horoscopo shows daily-reading-content instead of the 'silêncio' error.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause on production: the deployed backend build predates the /api/horoscope router. Kubernetes ingress therefore falls through to the frontend SPA (index.html) for /api/horoscope/*. The DailyReadingModal fetch expects JSON, JSON.parse fails, catch branch renders horoscope.ai.error ('Os astros estão em silêncio agora. Tente novamente em instantes.'). Fix: redeploy so backend image includes the horoscope router (and, per deployment agent note, the previously-blocked .env files). Confirmed by: `curl https://luxsexiaiii.com/api/horoscope/daily?sign=aries&lang=pt` returns Content-Type: text/html (SPA), whereas the preview returns Content-Type: application/json with full reading payload.
